source: PRD FR-4.5 and section 7; user clarification 2026-09-22
authorization: User selected: Fresh guest on an already-running hypervisor; guest resident memory.

boot.start: Begin creating a fresh guest instance on an already-running hypervisor/controller.
boot.stop: First validated useful response from that fresh guest.
include: guest execution through the first validated response
boot.aggregate: maximum observed over the preregistered campaign, with all raw samples retained

memory.scope: Peak guest resident memory, including guest code, data, stacks, heaps and guest drivers.

qualification: This profile fixes measurement scope; it does not establish that the target passes or that the full native/unikernel implementation exists.
